upstream_e1.selection: DoWhy is high-fit as an offline causal-refutation/mediation donor, but should be compared against a smaller F2-native deterministic paired-intervention harness.

source_architecture_map.observed_mechanism: Refuters generate a comparison distribution and evaluate whether the original/expected effect is compatible with it; AUTO switches to bootstrap at >=100 simulations and otherwise assumes a normal distribution.
source_architecture_map.wp507_mapping: Useful as a falsification pattern only. WP507 should retain exact intervention/control evidence as primary and may later report a bounded refutation statistic as secondary analysis.
source_architecture_map.reason: Current WP507 is a deterministic component contract and must not promote statistical compatibility into causal truth. The <100 normality fallback is especially unsuitable as an automatic authority rule for small paired F2 fixtures.

source_architecture_map.observed_mechanism: Replaces or permutes treatment, repeatedly re-estimates the effect, supports seeded randomness and tests whether zero lies in the placebo-effect distribution.
source_architecture_map.wp507_mapping: Strong conceptual match for SEMANTIC_PLACEBO_BROADCAST and SHUFFLED_RECIPIENT_BROADCAST controls already proposed by the WP507 discovery result. F2 can implement deterministic identity-bound placebo/shuffle fixtures without importing DoWhy.
source_architecture_map.reason: The upstream implementation pulls pandas, joblib, tqdm and DoWhy estimator types; WP507 already has exact broadcast/recipient identities and can build cheaper deterministic controls directly.

source_architecture_map.observed_mechanism: Models treatment->mediator and mediator->outcome in two stages, defaults to linear regression and currently supports a singleton mediator for mediation/front-door estimation.
source_architecture_map.wp507_mapping: UPTAKEN is a plausible mediator candidate between broadcast intervention and downstream recipient output, but regression mediation is not the immediate gate. First prove exact receipt/uptake/lesion-rescue chains; use mediation only as later offline analysis when repeated samples and assumptions are explicit.
source_architecture_map.reason: A fitted mediation estimate can be informative but cannot establish hidden-state uptake or canonical causality and introduces modeling assumptions absent from the deterministic contract.

source_architecture_map.observed_mechanism: Core package declares scipy, statsmodels, numpy, pandas, networkx, sympy, scikit-learn, joblib, econml, tqdm, causal-learn, numba and cvxpy among its dependencies.
source_architecture_map.wp507_mapping: Full runtime adoption is not justified for the current component gate.
source_architecture_map.reason: Dependency/runtime surface is much larger than the narrow falsification capability WP507 needs; it would increase packaging, ABI and measurement burden without replacing exact F2 intervention evidence.

recommended_f2_design.primary_evidence_path: exact matched intervention/control pair -> exact recipient delivery binding -> explicit semantic uptake evidence -> downstream output digest delta
optional_later_analysis: placebo/refutation statistic over repeated matched fixtures
mediation analysis with UPTAKEN as explicitly declared mediator
sensitivity/refuter cross-checks after enough samples exist
recommended_f2_design.authority_fence: DoWhy/refuter/mediation outputs remain offline analysis evidence only. They cannot mint delivery, semantic uptake, causal influence, world truth, effect success, GWT runtime, J-Space runtime or whole-system credit.

counterhypotheses.statement: Full DoWhy import provides materially stronger WP507 falsification than an F2-native deterministic matched-pair/placebo fixture.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: At a later claimed E3/E4 stage, run both on the same bounded evidence set and require DoWhy to detect an attribution/assumption failure missed by the native fixture at acceptable added dependency/latency cost.

counterhypotheses.statement: Treating UPTAKEN as a mediator is misleading because the receipt may be an instrumentation echo rather than a behaviorally causal state transition.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Keep delivery constant and lesion/rescue the exact uptake path; downstream output must change specifically with the uptake path before mediation analysis receives any causal interpretation.

recommended_next_objective.task: Build a deterministic no-provider fixture over synthetic/caller-supplied WP507-style matched pairs that demonstrates withheld, shuffled-recipient and semantic-placebo controls and shows exactly what a DoWhy-style refuter adds or fails to add. Do not import the full DoWhy dependency graph unless the fixture proves incremental information gain.
